title: Privacy Policy
description: Privacy Policy for pbzero.wiki. How we handle data, cookies, third-party advertising by Adsterra, and Google Analytics.

sections.title: Overview
sections.content:
This Privacy Policy describes how PBZero Wiki (“we”, “us”, or “the Site”) handles information when you visit pbzero.wiki. By using the Site, you agree to the practices described below.

We do not collect personal information directly. We do not require registration, accounts, or logins.

sections.title: Cookies
sections.content:
Cookies are small text files stored on your device. We use cookies and similar technologies for:

  • Measuring site usage and performance
  • Displaying relevant advertising (via third-party vendors)
  • Remembering display preferences

You can instruct your browser to refuse all cookies or to indicate when a cookie is being sent. However, some parts of the Site may not function properly without cookies.

sections.title: Third-Party Advertising
sections.content:
Advertising on this Site is provided by a third-party ad network, currently Adsterra.

  • Ad networks serve ads using cookies and similar technologies, and may target ads based on your visits to this and other websites. The specific advertisers shown depend on the network's demand partners and change over time.
  • Some of the formats this network uses - in particular pop-under ads - open a new browser window or tab when you interact with an ad. If you do not want that, please use an ad blocker or disable pop-ups for this Site in your browser.
  • We do not pass your name, email address or other identifying details to the ad network. What is shared is technical data such as cookie identifiers, IP address, browser and device information, which is how advertising on the open web works.
  • To opt out of interest-based advertising from many networks at once: US, EU, Canada.
  • Opting out limits personalised ads; you will still see advertising.

If we change who serves advertising on this Site, this page will be updated before the new provider is switched on.

sections.title: Analytics
sections.content:
We use Google Analytics 4 to understand how visitors use the Site. Google Analytics collects information such as how often users visit, what pages they visit, and what other sites they used prior to coming to our Site. We use this information only to improve the Site.

Google Analytics collects the IP address assigned to you on the date you visit the Site rather than your name or other personally identifying information. We do not combine the information collected through Google Analytics with personally identifiable information. Google's ability to use and share information collected is restricted by the Google Privacy Terms.

sections.title: Unofficial Fan Site
sections.content:
PBZero Wiki is an unofficial fan-run website. We are not affiliated with, endorsed by, or sponsored by S-Game (北京灵游坊科技) or any entity associated with Phantom Blade Zero.

All game names, trademarks, and copyrights belong to their respective owners. Content on this Site is provided for informational and educational purposes.

sections.title: Log Data
sections.content: Like most websites, our hosting provider may automatically record standard server log information such as your IP address, browser type, referring pages, and timestamps. This data is used for security and operational purposes and is not used to identify individual users.

sections.title: Children's Privacy
sections.content: The Site is not directed at children under 13. We do not knowingly collect personal information from children. If you believe a child has provided us with personal information, please contact us so we can take appropriate action.

sections.title: Changes to This Policy
sections.content: We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. Changes will be posted on this page with an updated revision date.

sections.title: Contact Us
sections.content: If you have any questions about this Privacy Policy, please contact us at contact@pbzero.wiki.
